Title: 2026-11-11 PTR Patch
Subtitle: === Heroes: Alexstrasza ===
CleanedNotes:
=== Heroes: Alexstrasza ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Alexstrasza's Cleansing Flame to be usable when not intended.

=== Heroes: Chromie ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Chromie's Once Again the First Time to provide a lower bonus for Echo mimic Sand Blast damage than Echo mimic Basic Attacks damage.

=== Heroes: Gazlowe ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 20
    • Bomb Toss
      • [Undocumented] Now reduces the cooldown of Xplodium Charge by 3 seconds.

=== Heroes: Junkrat ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Junkrat's Taste for Explosion to increase stacks before the damage was dealt.

=== Heroes: Medivh ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Medivh's Stable Portal to give less cooldown reduction than intended.

=== Heroes: Thrall ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Echo of the Elements
      • [Undocumented] Now loses 8 stacks upon death.
      • [Undocumented] Dying does not cause stacks to go below a Milestone threshold.
  • Level 13
    • Spirit Shield
      • [Undocumented] Spell Armor reduced from 70 to 50.

=== Heroes: Xal'atath ===
[Updates]
  Trait:
  • Void Volley [D]
    • [Undocumented] Quest damage bonus per stack reduced from 1% to 0.75%.
  Basic Abilities:
  • Shadow Mark [Q]
    • [Undocumented] Outer damage increased from 120 to 130.
    • [Undocumented] Inner damage increased from 60 to 65.
  • Void Step [E]
    • [Undocumented] Attack Damage per teleport while Void Step is active increased from 10% to 15%.
  Heroic Abilities:
  • Void Eruption [R1]
    • [Undocumented] Speed reduced by 12.5%.
    • [Undocumented] Flight damage per second reduced by 10%.
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Xal'atath's Void Volley to search around the target rather than around the projectile.

=== Heroes: Yrel ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Light of Karabor
      • [Undocumented] Healing bonus when hitting one enemy Hero reduced from 40% to 35%.
      • [Undocumented] Healing bonus when hitting more than one enemy Hero reduced from 80% to 70%.
  • Level 7
    • Divine Steed
      • [Undocumented] Duration increased from 3 to 4 seconds.
